posts.title: Always Off - Part One, The City
posts.description: The sky above Clapton is a deep grey-blue tonight. I can see some of the red lights on the totally cuboid newbuilds in Stratford off in the distance. The rain is beautiful, warm and clear. I smell white sage. I press play on my most-listened-to cassette, Ana Roxanne’s ~ ~ ~ , and sit here on my laptop. I’m thinking about water. posts.title: Uhhhh the hotel in Berlin
posts.description: Needing hand cream so walking 15 minutes to a pharmacy to buy cream and not wanting the one which was “urea” on the front but buying it anyway. It sort of stings but seems to work. Then finding a doner place nearby but going there and queuing and realising you have no cash and its cash only So walking back to the mall of berlin to look for a cash machine Its very cold You’re thinking about potsdam

posts.title: Music The Long Way
posts.description: My most listened-to playlist at the moment, by far, is called (Really) Long Soundbath. It's a bit of a misnomer in that I would hate to reduce any of my musical library to spa wallpaper, but it's apt in that I play these songs when I need to think and move and feel held. They are all at least 15 minutes long. We feature William Basinski's Watermusic I & II , Kara Lis Coverdale's Grafts , Stars of
